description: Scrape any web page: get clean Markdown, rendered/raw HTML, all links, SEO metadata, and/or a full-page screenshot in a single call. Costs 1 scraping credit per successful request regardless of how many formats you ask for. Screenshots use a full Chromium render (~5-15s); other formats are faster (~1-5s). Screenshots are returned as an image attachment. Use for reading article content, extracting page metadata, link discovery, or visual captures.

onlyMainContent.description: Strip navigation/footer/ads, keeping only the main article content. Default true.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds for the entire scrape. Default 30000.

url.description: Full URL to scrape. Must start with http:// or https://.

waitFor.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after page load (for lazy-loaded content). Default 0.

name: scrape_url
